subject: Lifelong bilingualism preserved pre-attentive hearing discrimination with age
script: From Agewell Brief: Lifelong bilingualism preserved pre-attentive hearing discrimination with age. New EEG research reveals that lifelong bilingualism preserves the brain's pre-attentive auditory discrimination, offering a buffer against age-related neural slowing.
